preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty and contain at most 30 characters.
The input string must consist of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a substring of the input string.

postconditions.expression: max(repeat_count(substring) for substring in substrings(stdin)) == repeat_count(return_value)
postconditions.description: The output substring must have the maximum repeat count among all substrings.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == max(len(substring) for substring in substrings(stdin) if repeat_count(substring) == repeat_count(return_value))
postconditions.description: Among substrings with the maximum repeat count, the output must have the maximum length.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((substring for substring in substrings(stdin) if repeat_count(substring) == repeat_count(return_value) and len(substring) == len(return_value)), key=lambda x: x)
postconditions.description: Among substrings with the maximum repeat count and length, the output must be the alphabetically latest.
